sources.entry: Condution - Create tasks, manage due dates, and filter with powerful perspectives.

summary.one_liner: Condution is an open-source, Electron-based task-management app for building checklists with projects, tags, due and start dates, and filtered perspectives.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a task list app where you create tasks, group them into projects, add tags, set due dates, and repeat tasks. Filters and "perspectives" let you narrow tasks by tag, project, or due date, and sort by defer date while hiding unavailable items. Tasks can have start and due times, not just dates. Tags carry weights that show up in the interface, including a loading bar on projects. Sequential projects can hide blocked tasks until they become ready, and parallel projects are also supported. The README also mentions "workspaces" that can be shared collaboratively, including with people without an account.
use_cases: project task tracking with due dates
filtering tasks by tag or project
scheduling tasks with start and due times
sequential task dependencies in a project
how_to_run: Clone the repository with submodules: git clone --recursive (or git submodule init && git submodule update)
Add src/backend/secrets.json containing Firebase keys under dbkeys.deploy and dbkeys.debug
Optionally install the Ionic CLI: npm install -g @ionic/cli
Run the web build with: yarn ionic:dist
Run the Electron hooks with: yarn electron:run (start the dev server first)
notable: Tags have weights that appear across the interface, including a loading bar on projects
Start and due dates support times, not just dates
Sequential projects can hide blocked tasks until they are ready
Workspaces can be shared with people who have no account
caveats: Requires Firebase keys in a local secrets.json file to run from source
The production build command was not yet written for v1.0, per the README
Patreon donations are mentioned as support; the README says the app is free and open source
keywords: free alternative to paid task apps
